Meet Blur AI

BLUR AI invites you on a journey of self-discovery. Instead of searching aimlessly in the crowd for that possible someone, take a moment to let AI guide you. Understand your essence and preferences in love. Then, allow your AI avatar to attract the perfect match just for you.

Subscribe Form

Subscribe to our newsletter

Welcome to our Newsletter Subscription Center. Sign up in the newsletter form below to receive the latest news and updates from our company.

Find Yourself

Initial Avatar Creation

Use visual and intuitive cards to express and understand your subconscious emotional preferences, forming the basis of your love-value AI avatar.

Daily Self-Discovery

Answer three daily questions to better understand yourself. Your responses train your avatar for improved accuracy.

Avatar Interaction

Converse with your avatar daily, sharing moods and stories. The avatar provides feedback (e.g., suggesting a song when you’re down) and optimizes its responses based on your preferences.

Let Love Find You

Aligning Hearts Through AI

We match users based on their avatars’ value dimensions, presenting a few potential matches daily.

Avatar Conversations

Users will chat with matches’ avatars first. These avatars act like personal wikis, gradually revealing information and sharing real stories to build intimacy.

Meet Your Unique Rose

If both are satisfied, you can unlock real chat. On the 3rd day, choose to continue or stop chatting. On the 7th day, opt to meet in person at a recommended location or limit to 3 messages per day until ready to meet.
